root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify (a) nerdctl's pull wrapper (pkg/imgutil/pull/pull.go) constructing RemoteOpts without WithPlatformMatcher when a non-default snapshotter is supplied, AND (b) containerd's pkg/unpack/unpacker.go requiring a non-empty platforms list. Report must cite both files and explain that the defaulting branch is skipped for override snapshotters.
evaluation_criteria: Names pkg/imgutil/pull/pull.go (or equivalent) on the nerdctl side
Names pkg/unpack/unpacker.go on the containerd side
States that the platforms list is empty because the defaulting branch is skipped for non-default snapshotters
References WithPlatformMatcher (or the equivalent RemoteOpt) as the missing piece

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least 4 hops from `nerdctl pull` through to the unpacker error. The chain must include nerdctl building opts, the snapshotter resolution, containerd's client.Pull entry, and the unpacker's empty-platforms branch.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions nerdctl Pull or pkg/imgutil/pull as the entry
Mentions client.Pull or containerd's pull.go (containerd v1.7.x has pull.go at the repository root)
Mentions the empty platforms list / 'no unpack platforms defined' as the failure point

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the nerdctl pull wrapper, the snapshotter resolver, and containerd's pkg/unpack module.

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete fix: (a) nerdctl-side adds WithPlatformMatcher to its RemoteOpt list, (b) containerd-side keeps defaulting platforms even when snapshotter is overridden, OR (c) both, with documentation update.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes nerdctl-side WithPlatformMatcher OR containerd-side defaulting fix
Identifies where the fix would live (nerdctl pull wrapper or containerd unpacker)
